_doc: Constants of a1_rde_tournament.py [X-RDET] (S41 2026-09-27): the nozzle tournament on the Q2D THOR_CAv3 outflow -- nozzles designed on the Stechmann time-mean state against nozzles designed with the phases voting.

units.note: 1 bar = 1e5 Pa (the SI definition): the ambients and the phase states are declared in bar

source.note: the Q2D THOR_CAv3 limit cycle (leg D, t 15.5 ms, the last chamber cell column at x 104.80 mm, 1799 azimuthal cells, every one supersonic -- thermally choked) extracted by RDE/handoff/f3_2026-09-25/q2d_exit_extract.py; the nozzle inlet annulus = the Q2D exit face (outer radius 68 mm, gap 14.15 mm at x 107.26 mm, Ly 422.78 mm); the Stechmann nozzle = GENO's Migdal perfect pair (nozzle_type 9) for the TIME-MEAN state (theta-arithmetic: a single rotating wave makes a period at a point equal to all angles at an instant, T0) adapted at the tournament's ambient pa_bar (an altitude ambient: the mean exit static pressure is 0.34 bar, the time-mean stagnation 1.42 bar); families = the phase counts (equal azimuthal sectors = equal durations); T_tab = the constant-gamma tables' temperature range (the builder's absolute [1050, 3900] K clamps the RDE exhaust expanded below ~1000 K; 300 K covers every phase's exit)

gates.note: the gates of the carrier's new options on the tournament posing: the capped posing (cap, ends at the cap u0, the lip free) at the tournament ambient; over_pa_bar = an ambient that over-expands the cut Stechmann nozzle enough for a wall to detach under Summerfield (the separation-closure gate); fd_step, knot = the central difference of the phase-voting replay gate

eval.note: the tournament's designs: S0 = the Stechmann perfect pair cut at the cap (the start of the walks, read from the S1 record's W_start), S1 = the capped walk on the Stechmann time-mean state (its class at that state), V1m = the 12 phases voting on the thrust with the fold class read at the time-mean state only, V1 = the phases voting with EVERY phase shock-free and attached (the class a KS soft-min over the phases' fold margins and their Summerfield wall margins, TWOP_MU_CLASS=all TWOP_SEP_CLASS=1), V1s = V1 with every phase's free vortex in the march (the meridional problem with its swirl, TWOP_SWIRL=1); evaluators = the mean state, the phase families (K 24 = the binning check) and the families with their swirl ('+swirl'); g0 for the specific impulse (mixture: thrust / (the Q2D mass flow g0)); '@fine' = the judge re-marched at the fine rung fine_rung (the S41 fine rung (280, 61)): a coarse-grid difference between designs counts only if it survives this paired refinement (M0 LINE ADDENDUM S41 item (1))

swirl_gates.note: the two-wall radial-equilibrium duct (the swirl march's exact W-2 world with the shroud as the top wall): straight walls at y_plug and y_shroud, the plug to x_end, the shroud beyond it (x_shroud_end, the lip not reached), a uniform meridional inflow at Mach M with the free vortex w/u = w_over_u at the plug; rungs = (K stations, N rows) halving; fd_ladder = the central-difference steps of SW-4's ladder (the derivative along the knot is ~5e-5 with the swirl: a single step's truncation error is not negligible against it)

jet_gates.note: the free-jet gates on the tournament posing: u0_shroud = the shroud end's sigmoid start with the plug at the cap (0: the lip at mid-way, the plug running on beyond it; the lip's first characteristic lands past the plug tip, measured 2026-09-27, so the jet cannot reach the plug); over_pa_bar = an ambient above the cut nozzle's lip pressure (the over-expanded lip: out of class by the lip margin); knot and fd_step of the replay gradient check; fine_rung = (K, N) with K-1 and N-1 doubled from the coarse (140, 31): the residuals' order of convergence (JT-2b)

offdesign.note: the off-design sweep: the ambients (bar) around the tournament's 0.05 bar up to where the cut Stechmann nozzle detaches under Summerfield (0.30 bar, T-5b) and beyond; the judges = the time-mean state, the 12 phases, the 12 phases with their swirl
